'''Lollama''' is a [[Grass]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Slobberlama]] at 6 bronze stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "The drool that's always hanging from Lollama's mouth drives clean-minded Tatari away. In theory, Lollama should be very popular among [[Zobos]]."

Lollama is a purple rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
TBA

== Evolution Trial ==
Lollama's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 bronze stars/19 copies. To evolve it into [[Slobberlama]] you need to complete the following task:

* Bring Lollama to [[Zobo Horde Invasion|Horde Invasion]] 3 times. Drown those Zobos in slobber!
